name: DreamLedger Billboard - Small
description: Claim a 100 x 100 pixel block on DreamLedger's one-million-pixel public canvas. Inspired by the original million-pixel billboard idea and physical-world public-place advertising, the product turns scarce digital surface area into a programmable commercial object. Buyers submit an image and destination; automated checks run first, with human review before publication. The longer-term vision is an agent-readable advertising surface where software agents can discover, evaluate and purchase defined digital real estate.

positioning.promise: Buy a defined piece of digital surface area and attach a destination to it.
positioning.not_claimed: No guarantee of traffic, impressions, rankings, or sales.
